name: G502 X
author: Quarezz
description: G502 X LIGHTSPEED charge and DPI in the Omarchy bar. Credits: Omarchy power panel, Solaar, AirPods for Omarchy

barWidget.description: Charge color on the bar, charging state, and DPI switching

schema.label: Show charge on the bar
schema.description: When on, the bar shows the percent next to the mouse. Right-click the widget to toggle.

schema.label: Low-battery warning
schema.description: Percent. A notification is sent once when the mouse falls to this while discharging.

schema.label: Sensitivity presets
schema.description: Comma-separated DPI values for the preset buttons, e.g. 800, 1200, 1600. Values the sensor cannot take (100-25600 in steps of 50) are ignored, as are duplicates. Up to 8, shown lowest first.
